mapper.select: SELECT * FROM safety_dict_item where is_use = "1" and supper_id = #{supperId};
SELECT id, item_code, item_name, item_order, supper_id FROM safety_dict_item WHERE supper_id = #{id} AND is_use = "1" ORDER BY update_time DESC

SELECT id, item_code, item_name, item_order, supper_id, pid FROM safety_dict_item WHERE
supper_id = #{query.supperId} AND is_use = "1"
and item_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.itemName}, '%')
and pid is null
ORDER BY update_time DESC
